proof_body:
by
  intro n r 𝒜 hr hn hs hi
  refine Finset.erdos_ko_rado ?_ (fun s h => hs s h) (by omega)
  intro s h t ht hd
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hi s h t ht
  rw [Finset.mem_inter] at ha
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd ha.1 ha.2
target_source: ∀ (n r : ℕ) (𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), 1 ≤ r → 2 * r ≤ n → (∀ s ∈ 𝒜, s.card = r) → (∀ s ∈ 𝒜, ∀ t ∈ 𝒜, (s ∩ t).Nonempty) → 𝒜.card ≤ (n - 1).choose (r - 1)
